name: warm-capabilities
description: Figments host flow: 31 resident host tools guarded by RunSpec.capabilities, warm catalogue, a quiet clean model turn, then a fresh text document attachment and host document-tool publication. Setup and fresh-document turns each check one authorized host operation; quiet checks zero tool executions and zero snapshot/manifest/link_payload callbacks. SQL statements, changed rows and WAL bytes are counted independently.

turns.user: Warm the host catalogue with the document capability.
A quiet model turn with the same document capability and unchanged host catalogue.
